mintAuthority.headline: SilverTimes mints STT on Ethereum via a two-of-three Safe with immediate admin role control and four-of-six Safe proxy upgrades.
mintAuthority.summary: STT is an OpenZeppelin TransparentUpgradeableProxy on Ethereum delegating to verified ComplianceToken. MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE sit with a 2-of-3 Safe v1.5.0 with no on-chain supply cap, while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE sits with a 2-of-3 Safe v1.4.1 that shares two signers with the minter Safe and can grant or revoke any role immediately. ProxyAdmin upgrades, ENFORCER_ROLE forceTransfer, and FEE_MANAGER_ROLE sit with a 4-of-6 Safe v1.4.1 with zero timelock. All three Safes have empty modules and zero guards; reserve verification is self-reported management affirmation with Brink's holding slips rather than independent accounting assurance.

review.evidence: Pinned Ethereum reads at finalized block 26505987 (2026-11-27T10:37:11Z) and full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history since deployment block 25521339 establish uncapped 2-of-3 Safe minting, immediate 2-of-3 Safe role administration (sharing two signers with the minter Safe), and immediate 4-of-6 Safe TransparentUpgradeableProxy upgrades. Monthly management Transparency Reports compare Brink's Hong Kong silver weight (1,019.32330 kg) to on-chain supply (32,771.957 STT), supporting internal-ledger reconciliation without independent accounting-firm assurance or prudential supervision.
